title: 01_secret.txt
story: Sizga sirli matn fayli berilgan. U oddiy ko'rinadi, lekin aslida shifrlangan. Bu eng asosiy kodlash usullaridan biri.
objective: Fayldagi Base64 kodlangan matnni dekodlang va flagni toping.
hints: Base64 har doim = belgisi bilan tugaydi

title: 02_imperator.txt
story: Qadimgi Rim imperatori Yuliy Tsezar o'z xabarlarini shifrlash uchun oddiy usuldan foydalangan.
objective: ROT13 (Sezar 13 qadam) shifrini dekodlang.
hints: Har bir harfni 13 ta oldinga suring

title: 03_hexdump.txt
story: Hex dump — bu kompyuter xotirasidagi ma'lumotlarni 16-lik formatda ko'rsatish usuli.
objective: 16-lik (hex) kodlangan matnni ASCII ga o'girib, flagni toping.
hints: Har bir hex bayt 2 ta belgidan iborat

title: 04_robot.txt
story: Robotlar faqat 0 va 1 ni tushunadi. Bu fayl robot tilida yozilgan.
objective: 8-bitli binary (0 va 1) kodlangan matnni ASCII ga o'girib, flagni toping.

title: 05_radio.txt
story: Radio aloqasi orqali uzatilgan signal — Morze alifbosi bilan kodlangan.
objective: Nuqta va chiziqchalardan iborat Morze kodini dekodlang.

title: 06_mirror.txt
story: Atbash shifri — bu alifboni teskari o'giruvchi qadimgi shifrlash usuli.
objective: Atbash shifrini dekodlang (A=Z, B=Y, C=X...).

title: 07_vigenere.txt
story: Vigenere shifri — bu polialfavitli shifrlash usuli, TEMUR kaliti ishlatilgan.
objective: TEMUR kaliti bilan Vigenere shifrini dekodlang.
hints: Vigenere — bir nechta Sezar shifrlarining kombinatsiyasi

title: 08_xor.bin
story: XOR — bu eng oddiy va eng kuchli shifrlash operatsiyalaridan biri.
objective: Har bir baytni 0x42 (66) bilan XOR qilib, flagni toping.

title: 09_onion.txt
story: Piyoz kabi qatlamli shifrlash. Har bir qatlamni ochish kerak.
objective: Base64 decode → Hex decode → Reverse qilib, flagni toping.
hints: Avval base64, keyin hex, oxirida teskari o'girish

title: 10_rsa.txt
story: RSA shifri — zamonaviy kriptografiyaning asosi. Lekin kichik tub sonlar bilan zaif.
objective: RSA parametrlari: p=61, q=53, e=17. d ni topib, flagni oching.

title: 11_dump.bin
story: Binary fayl — ko'rinmas ko'p ma'lumot. Lekin matnli qatorlar yashiringan.
objective: strings buyrug'i bilan fayldan matnli qatorlarni ajratib oling.

title: 12_broken.png
story: Bu PNG rasm ochilmayapti. Sehrli baytlar buzilgan.
objective: PNG headerini tuzatib, rasmni oching yoki tEXt chunkini o'qing.

title: 13_not_an_image.jpg
story: Fayl nomi .jpg, lekin aslida boshqa format.
objective: Fayl aslida ZIP arxiv ekanligini aniqlang va uni ochib, flagni toping.

title: 14_photo.jpg
story: Rasm oddiy ko'rinadi, lekin metadata ko'p narsani aytadi.
objective: exiftool orqali Comment maydonidagi Base64 ni dekodlang.

title: 15_access.log
story: Server logi — hujumchining barcha harakatlari shu yerda.
objective: 137-qatordagi GET so'rov ichidan tokenni olib, flagni toping.

title: 16_eof_secret.jpg
story: JPEG rasmning oxiridan keyin yashirin ma'lumot bor.
objective: JPEG FF D9 (EOF) baytidan keyingi yozuvni o'qib, flagni toping.
hints: har qanday JPEG fayl FF D9 bilan tugaydi
hexedit yoki binwalk bilan keyingi qismni ko'ring

title: 17_bank.csv
story: Bank tranzaksiyalari — lekin ba'zilari oddiy emas.
objective: ghost_hacker tranzaksiyalaridagi memo harflarini yig'ib, flagni toping.

title: 18_memory.dmp
story: Xotira dampi — RAM ning to'liq nusxasi.
objective: RAM dampdan SECRET_FLAG= o'zgaruvchisini toping.

title: 19_document.pdf
story: PDF — bu oddiy matn formatidagi fayl.
objective: PDF ni oddiy matn sifatida ochib, streamni o'qib, flagni toping.
hints: stream va endstream orasiga e'tibor bering

title: 20_traffic.pcap
story: Tarmoq trafigi — barcha paketlar yozilgan.
objective: Wireshark'da HTTP POST so'rovdagi X-Secret-Flag headerini toping.

title: 21_invisible.txt
story: Matn oddiy ko'rinadi, lekin unda ko'rinmas belgilar bor.
objective: Zero-Width (\u200b=0, \u200c=1) bitlarini ASCII ga o'girib, flagni toping.

title: 22_whitespace.txt
story: Faqat bo'sh joy va tab belgilaridan iborat matn.
objective: Qator oxiridagi Space (0) va Tab (1) larni dekodlab, flagni toping.

title: 23_poem.txt
story: She'r chiroyli ko'rinadi, lekin yashirin xabar bor.
objective: Har bir qatorning 1-belgisini birlashtirib, flagni toping.

title: 24_lsb.bmp
story: Rasm piksellarida yashirin ma'lumot bor.
objective: 54-baytdan boshlab piksellarning oxirgi (LSB) bitlarini yig'ib, flagni toping.

title: 25_sound.wav
story: Ovoz faylida ma'lumot yashiringan.
objective: WAV fayl oxiridagi INFO chunk'ni o'qib, flagni toping.

title: 26_capitals.txt
story: Matn ichida maxsus belgilar yashiringan.
objective: Matndan faqat katta harflar va qavslarni ajratib, flagni toping.

title: 27_logo.svg
story: SVG — bu vektor grafik format, oddiy XML.
objective: SVG kod ichidan opacity="0" bo'lgan <text> elementini toping.

title: 28_haystack.txt
story: Katta matn ichida igna yashiringan.
objective: 334-qatordagi uzunroq satrni Hex'dan matnga o'girib, flagni toping.

title: 29_offset.bin
story: Binary faylda ma'lum offset'dan keyin flag yashiringan.
objective: Faylning 512-baytidan (0x200 offset) boshlab o'qib, flagni toping.

title: 30_matrix.txt
story: Matritsa ko'rinishida yashiringan binary ma'lumot.
objective: # = 1, . = 0 qilib binary matritsani o'qib, flagni toping.
hints: har bir qator binary satrga aylanadi

title: 31_vault.py
story: Python skript flagni tekshiradi, lekin kodni tushunish mumkin.
objective: target massividagi ASCII raqamlarni chr() qilib, flagni toping.

title: 32_script.js
story: JavaScript kodi obfuscated (chalkashtirilgan).
objective: \xNN ko'rinishidagi JS hex satrni konsolda chiqarib, flagni toping.

title: 33_bytecode.dis
story: Python bytecode — bu kompilyatsiya qilingan Python kodi.
objective: LOAD_CONST instruktsiyalaridagi qismlarni birlashtirib, flagni toping.

title: 34_checker.c
story: C kodi flagni matematik tenglamalar orqali tekshiradi.
objective: C koddagi tenglamalardan 10 ni ayirib, ASCII flagni toping.

title: 35_bitshift.py
story: Bitlarni aylantirish (rotate) — bu qiziqarli operatsiya.
objective: Bitlarni 2 marta o'ngga aylantirish (ROR 2) orqali flagni toping.

title: 36_vm.asm
story: Assembly kod virtual mashina uchun.
objective: MOV R0 qiymatlarini 0x55 bilan XOR qilib, flagni toping.

title: 37_regex.js
story: Regex — qolip bo'yicha matn tekshirish vositasi.
objective: Regex qolipiga mos satrni tiklab, flagni toping (7{3} -> 777).

title: 38_custom.py
story: Maxsus alifbo bo'yicha shifrlangan.
objective: Satrni teskari o'girib, ASCII kodiga 3 qo'shib, flagni toping.

title: 39_program.elf
story: ELF — Linux bajariluvchi fayli.
objective: .rodata qismidagi baytlarni 0x15 bilan XOR qilib, flagni toping.

title: 40_prng.py
story: PRNG — Pseudo-Random Number Generator.
objective: random.seed(2026) bilan bir xil ketma-ketlikni yaratib XOR qiling.
hints: bir xil seed = bir xil ketma-ketlik

title: 41_token.jwt
story: JWT — JSON Web Token, autentifikatsiya uchun.
objective: JWT payload qismini Base64 decode qilib, flagni toping.

title: 42_backup.sql
story: SQL damp — ma'lumotlar bazasining nusxasi.
objective: SQL dampdagi admin parolini Base64 dan chiqarib, flagni toping.

title: 43_commit.patch
story: Git commit — kod o'zgarishlar tarixi.
objective: Git diff'dagi o'chirilgan (-) qatordagi kalitni olib, flagni toping.

title: 44_robots.txt
story: robots.txt — qidiruv tizimlari uchun qo'llanma.
objective: Disallow qilingan yashirin URL ichini o'qib, flagni toping.

title: 45_response.http
story: HTTP javob — server tomonidan yuborilgan ma'lumot.
objective: X-Flag-Part-1, 2, 3 sarlavhalarini birlashtirib, flagni toping.

title: 46_matryoshka.txt
story: Matryoshka qo'g'irchoq — ichida boshqasi, ichida yana boshqasi.
objective: Ketma-ket 5 marta Base64 decode qilib, flagni toping.

title: 47_esoteric.bf
story: Brainfuck — bu minimalistik esoterik dasturlash tili.
objective: Brainfuck kodni ishga tushirib yoki + larni sanab, flagni toping.

title: 48_config.env
story: Muhit fayli — maxfiy sozlamalar uchun.
objective: .env ichidagi PART_A + PART_B + PART_C ni ulab, flagni toping.

title: 49_graphql.json
story: GraphQL — zamonaviy API so'rov tili.
objective: GraphQL sxemadagi deprecated_secret izohini o'qib, flagni toping.

title: 50_dns_c2.json
story: DNS — tarmoq protokoli, lekin C2 server sifatida ishlatilishi mumkin.
objective: DNS subdomenlaridagi hex bo'laklarni yig'ib dekodlab, flagni toping.
